what_happened: Vendor onboarding for the identity provider had no named owner; sandbox access was requested late and delayed integration
recommendation: Add a vendor/third-party onboarding workstream with a named owner to the standard project plan

what_happened: Weekly status went amber for two weeks before the sponsor was told the launch date was at risk
recommendation: Adopt the RAG escalation rule: report amber the moment a milestone is threatened

what_happened: Reusable API design from a prior project cut build time for the ticket service significantly
recommendation: Promote the shared API template into the engineering standards library

what_happened: UAT had no dedicated test environment so testing competed with development
recommendation: Provision a separate UAT environment in the plan before the build phase

what_happened: Daily stand-ups drifted into problem-solving and ran over 30 minutes
recommendation: Timebox stand-ups to 15 minutes and move problem-solving to follow-up sessions

what_happened: Early agreement on an explicit out-of-scope list prevented several late scope disputes
recommendation: Keep the explicit out-of-scope list as a required charter element

what_happened: Support-agent training was planned too late and risked the go-live
recommendation: Schedule end-user training to finish one week before launch in the plan
